entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: But... you're confined in reality now,[n]even after you escaped the prison[n]within your heart...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: What an ironic turn of events because[n]you wished for the fortune of others[n]over your own well-being.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Still... it will do. You chose the correct[n]path with your own volition.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You did not compromise your beliefs for[n]personal gain to the very end.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The last arcana you have taken hold of[n]is "The World."

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: It is the willpower to stand up in this[n]world on your own feet, swayed by[n]none.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: That will become the basis of hope[n]toward a future with your teammates[n]who share the same belief.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Now that you've gained that power,[n]you are no longer an existence that[n]wanders alone...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: My own duties end here as well...
